result.title: Federated Learning of Car Aerodynamics Surrogates with Spectral Optimizers
result.summary: Neural surrogates predict the aerodynamic forces on a car in seconds, compared with hours for a CFD simulation, but training them requires thousands of CFD simulations of different car designs, which car manufacturers keep proprietary. Federated learning allows several manufacturers to train a shared surrogate without exchanging data. We study which federated optimizer brings such a surrogate closest to one trained on pooled data. On DrivAerNet++, we train a Transolver surrogate across six clients that each hold cars of a single body type, and we compare three spectral optimizers, which orthogonalize the update of each weight matrix (FedMuon and two methods we propose, FedMARS-M and FedOLion), with three non-spectral ones (FedAvg, SCAFFOLD-Adam and FedLion), all tuned with the same protocol. FedMuon and FedMARS-M reach a drag error within 2% of centralized training with Muon, using two to four local epochs per round. The non-spectral methods perform best with sixteen local epochs, the largest number we tested, and still have a 17 to 37% higher drag error than FedMARS-M. We relate this gap to the low stable rank of the weight gradients, for which an orthogonalized step yields about twice the first-order decrease of a gradient step of the same spectral norm. Code: https://github.com/armanbolatov/fedmars_drivaernet

AI.brief_summary: 论文比较联邦学习中谱优化器（FedMuon、FedMARS-M、FedOLion）与非谱优化器训练汽车气动代理模型的效果，并将差距归因于权重梯度的低稳定秩。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究的是联邦优化器与气动代理建模，未涉及视觉/多模态推理的内部状态、证据使用或停止决策；谱优化器属通用训练手段，未与 latent 推理状态或视觉信息利用建立具体联系，缺少可核查的借鉴线索。
